scripts.roll: rimraf -g nodejs/docs/* && rimraf -g python/docs/* && rimraf -g java/docs/* && rimraf -g dotnet/docs/* && rimraf -g images/* && bun run sync-upstream-scripts && node src/generate.js
scripts.prepare-dotnet: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r dotnet/* .
scripts.prepare-java: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r java/* .
scripts.prepare-nodejs: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r nodejs/* .
scripts.prepare-python: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r python/* .
scripts.build-nodejs: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r nodejs/* . && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 docusaurus build --out-dir=build
scripts.build-python: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r python/* . && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 docusaurus build --out-dir=build/python
scripts.build-java: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r java/* . && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 docusaurus build --out-dir=build/java
scripts.build-dotnet: bun run cleanup && shx cp -r dotnet/* . && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 docusaurus build --out-dir=build/dotnet
scripts.build: tsc && rimraf -g build && bun run build-nodejs && bun run build-python && bun run build-java && bun run build-dotnet
scripts.version-dotnet: bun run prepare-dotnet && docusaurus docs:version stable && cp -r docs/* dotnet/docs/ && cp -r versioned_docs/* dotnet/versioned_docs/ && cp -r images dotnet/versioned_docs/ && cp -r versioned_sidebars/* dotnet/versioned_sidebars/ && cp versions.json dotnet/
scripts.version-java: bun run prepare-java && docusaurus docs:version stable && cp -r docs/* java/docs/ && cp -r versioned_docs/* java/versioned_docs/ && cp -r images java/versioned_docs/ && cp -r versioned_sidebars/* java/versioned_sidebars/ && cp versions.json java/
scripts.version-node: bun run prepare-nodejs && docusaurus docs:version stable && cp -r docs/* nodejs/docs/ && cp -r versioned_docs/* nodejs/versioned_docs/ && cp -r images nodejs/versioned_docs/ && cp -r versioned_sidebars/* nodejs/versioned_sidebars/ && cp versions.json nodejs/
scripts.version-python: bun run prepare-python && docusaurus docs:version stable && cp -r docs/* python/docs/ && cp -r versioned_docs/* python/versioned_docs/ && cp -r images python/versioned_docs/ && cp -r versioned_sidebars/* python/versioned_sidebars/ && cp versions.json python/
scripts.cleanup: rimraf -g docs versioned_docs versioned_sidebars docusaurus.config.ts versions.json sidebars.js
scripts.version-all: bun run version-python && bun run version-node && bun run version-java && bun run version-dotnet
